These Terms are a binding agreement between you and Isofit. A few points matter enough to say up front: Atlas is an AI system, not a person. What it tells you is general fitness information that can be wrong, and it is never medical advice. Exercise carries real physical risk, and decisions about your training and your health are yours. 1. Agreement to These Terms

These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your use of the Isofit iOS application and the web services at isofit.app (together, "the Service"), operated by Isofit ltd. ("Isofit," "we," "us").

Our Privacy Policy explains how we collect and handle your personal data. It is part of your agreement with us.

You are responsible for your account credentials and for activity that occurs under your account. Keep your password secure and notify us at support@isofit.app if you believe your account has been compromised. You may not share, sell, or transfer your account.

4. Memberships, Billing, and Cancellation

The core workout logger is available free of charge. Paid membership tiers unlock additional features, including expanded Atlas access. The features, prices, and billing period of each tier are shown before you purchase.

Billing. Apple processes membership payments through the App Store, and RevenueCat manages subscription status on our behalf. We do not store your full card details.
Renewal and cancellation. Paid memberships renew automatically until you cancel. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period; where you purchased through Apple, Apple's subscription management and refund processes apply.
Changes. We may change membership pricing or included features with advance notice. Changes take effect at your next renewal.

Canceling a membership does not delete your account or data — see Section 10 of the Privacy Policy for account deletion.

5. Atlas and AI-Generated Content

"Atlas" is Isofit's AI coaching feature. "AI Content" means any output generated or synthesized by artificial-intelligence or automated systems within the Service, including Atlas chat responses, form-check feedback, training insights, progress analyses and visualizations (including the body graph and other Progress outputs), and structured training suggestions such as workout programs, exercise prescriptions, and training targets.

5.1 Atlas Is an AI System, Not a Person

Atlas is an automated system built on artificial-intelligence models operated by third-party providers. It is not a human being. No human reviews or composes Atlas's responses before you see them, even when a response feels conversational or personal.

5.2 AI Content Can Be Wrong

AI Content is generated automatically and may be inaccurate, incomplete, outdated, or unsuitable for you — for example, poorly matched to your physical condition, injury history, experience level, available equipment, or circumstances. It reflects patterns in training data, not verified knowledge about you. Do not rely on AI Content without checking it against your own judgment, and where it matters, against a qualified professional. You decide what to act on; that decision is yours alone.

5.3 Not Medical Advice

AI Content is general fitness and educational information only. It is not medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment, and it is not a substitute for the advice of a physician or other qualified health provider. Consult a healthcare provider before starting or changing an exercise program, especially if you have a medical condition, an injury, or any doubt about whether an activity is safe for you. Never disregard professional medical advice, or delay seeking it, because of something Atlas said. If you experience pain, dizziness, shortness of breath, or other concerning symptoms, stop exercising and seek medical attention. If you think you may have a medical emergency, call emergency services immediately — do not use Atlas.

5.4 No Professional Relationship

Your use of Atlas does not create a trainer-client, doctor-patient, therapist-patient, dietitian-client, or any other professional or fiduciary relationship between you and Isofit. Atlas is not a licensed professional of any kind.

5.5 Training Suggestions Are Starting Points

Atlas may produce structured, actionable outputs — programs, prescribed exercises, sets, loads, or targets. These are automatically generated suggestions to help you organize training, not instructions. You choose whether and how to follow them, and you are responsible for scaling them to your own abilities, using proper form and appropriate equipment, and training in a safe environment.

5.6 Your Inputs to Atlas

You keep ownership of the messages, images, voice recordings, and other content you submit to Atlas ("Inputs"). You grant Isofit a worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free license to host, store, reproduce, and process your Inputs — including transmitting them to the AI model providers identified in the Privacy Policy — as needed to operate, provide, maintain, secure, and improve the Service, consistent with the Privacy Policy. We do not use your Inputs or your fitness or health data to train AI models without your express opt-in consent, and Apple Health (HealthKit) data is never used to train AI models. Atlas memory and personalization are controlled by the consent settings described in the Privacy Policy.

Do not submit other people's personal or health information to Atlas, and do not use Atlas for anything time-critical or safety-critical.

6. Assumption of Risk

Physical exercise is inherently risky. Risks include muscle and joint injury, aggravation of existing conditions, cardiac events, and, in rare cases, serious injury or death. By using the Service, you voluntarily accept these risks for the activities you choose to perform. You are responsible for your own health decisions, including obtaining medical clearance where appropriate, knowing your limits, and choosing activities, loads, equipment, and environments that are safe for you — whether or not an activity was suggested by AI Content.

Nothing in these Terms excludes or limits liability that cannot be excluded or limited under applicable law.

15. Termination

You may stop using the Service at any time and may request account deletion as described in the Privacy Policy. We may suspend or terminate your access if you violate these Terms, if required by law, or if we discontinue the Service, with notice where practicable. Sections 5, 6, 12, 13, 14, and 17 survive termination.

16. Changes to the Service and These Terms

Isofit is an evolving product. Features — including Atlas's capabilities, underlying AI models, and behavior — may change, be added, or be removed. We may update these Terms from time to time; if a change is material, we will notify you by email or in-app notice and update the Effective Date above. Your continued use of the Service after notice takes effect constitutes acceptance of the updated Terms. If you do not agree, stop using the Service.

These Terms, and any dispute arising out of or relating to them or the Service, are governed by the laws of the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania, without regard to its conflict-of-laws rules. You and Isofit agree to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts located in Pennsylvania, except that either party may bring an individual claim in small-claims court where it qualifies.

If the law of your home jurisdiction gives you mandatory consumer rights, or the right to bring or defend proceedings in your local courts, nothing in this section takes those rights away.

Before filing any claim, please contact us at support@isofit.app — most concerns can be resolved informally.
